name: Morita 9mm Assault Rifle Mk. 1
description_html:
Starship Troopers' Morita Rifle, in a 9mm Assault Rifle configuration.

The Morita Assault Rifle, you know what this thing is; especially if you're familiar with Starship Troopers, now in the hands of the finest crayon eaters and yours truly. Now your employment within the Black Mesa Research Facility is 100% guaranteed with this weapon.

While not exactly a 1:1 recreation of the movie gun itself (I had taken some artistic liberties with this), hopefully it'll be familiar enough that it'll satisfy your desire to roleplay as one of sci-fi's most well known cannon fodder in history.

What it contains:

  • The gun itself, in all three forms (p_, w_ and v_models) and the HECU holding them.
  • A custom firing sfx by UwU4181 and some extra foley
  • Sprite weapon selection UI graphics and its own muzzleflash sprite


Blue Shift and Opposing Force versions coming soon (maybe, idk, prolly in a hundred business days, I work that slow)

name: AKS-74U + TISHINA GL
description_html:
NovaRain AKS-74U from HIT.
Well, the model was good, but I think it was too simple, so I remade it, if you can call it that.

2 variants:
  • ak74u + gl tishina
  • ak74u + silencer + gl tishina

It also includes 3 types of texture:
  • Black
  • Cod4 style (I don't know how to say this combination)

  • Normal


Not everyone knows how to operate the Jet Half-Life Model Viewer to change textures, so I did it this way so you only have to put the model in your game, instead of just uploading the textures.

include PeeWee models
Add new Hgrunt models
Add new barney models

info:
ak74u normal polys: 4840
ak74u silenced polys: 5016

My version :D

It's my fault that I'm not usually complacent, but I thought it would look more tactical if I added other accessories.



The version I originally created was going to have a PSO-1 scope like this skin I found, but I discovered that this is unthinkable:

  1. The AKS-74U is a very short weapon. The PSO-1 has a very long sight.
  2. The AKS-74U has an effective range of about 200-300 meters, while the PSO-1 is designed to fire up to 1000 meters with a long-barreled rifle.

So I decided to put something logical and iconic on it. Sorry to the person who originally thought a PSO1 scope would work on the gun; I put a Kobra sight on it instead.



2 variants:

  • ak74u + gl tishina + kobra sight = 8900 polys
  • ak74u + gl tishika + silencer + kobra sight = 9210 polys


opfor: https://gamebanana.com/mods/652405
blue shift: https://gamebanana.com/mods/657673

(Outdated)? Well, I don't know, It works perfectly for me in Half-Life.

ENJOY!!
